name: Memories Off: Yubikiri no Kioku - Futari no Fuuryuuan
original_name: メモリーズオフ ゆびきりの記憶 ふたりの風流庵
source:
A fandisc included in the special Sweets edition of the PSP release, later included in the PS3 and PSVita version with added content.

Shin Inaho asks the protagonist to help him with an advert for Furyuuan. He'll have to go around several places with his love interests and take their pictures.
translation:
一款随PSP版特别Sweets套装附赠的Fan Disc，后来经过内容扩充，又收录于PS3版和PSVita版中。

稻穗信请主人公帮忙为风流庵拍摄广告。主人公得带着恋人们走访多处景点，为她们拍下照片。
